@graph.name: About AIVideosUGC: AI Product Photos and Video Ads
@graph.description: AIVideosUGC helps shop owners create product photos, short video ads, and presenter-led videos from a product image or page. Learn who operates the service and how it helps.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a creator-style clip of my product?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose an AI actor, add your product, and make a creator-style video. You can review and adjust the message before downloading it.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same AI actor on my next ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose the same AI actor for another video to keep a familiar look. You can change the script, voice, or product each time.

mainEntity.name: Can I make shop ads without booking a studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Start with a product photo or page, choose a scene or presenter, and review the result before you download it.
Visit the Pricing page for current plan options. You can see the credit cost for a photo or video job before it starts.

mainEntity.name: Can I post the ad on my store and on social channels?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can download a result for your product page or social channels. Review your plan terms and each channel's rules before using it in a campaign.

mainEntity.name: What can a shop make from one product photo?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can prepare listing photos, product videos, and short ads from product images or a public product page.

mainEntity.name: Can my product video include a voice and captions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add a voice and captions, then review the result before you download it.
AIVideosUGC is operated by BLYDEY INC. NARUEBET NAKPHONG is the company's legal representative. For help, contact support@aivideosugc.com.
